## Checklist

### For Test Cases

- [ ] Case follows `docs/case-template.yaml` format
- [ ] Case has clear `expected_decision`
- [ ] Case has appropriate `failure_labels`
- [ ] Case runs successfully: `book-of-fail --adapter replay --suite {suite}`
- [ ] No PII, secrets, or real company names in fixtures

### For Code Changes

- [ ] Code formatted with Black
- [ ] Type hints added for public functions
- [ ] Existing tests still pass
- [ ] New tests added if applicable

### For Documentation

- [ ] Spelling and grammar checked
- [ ] Links verified
- [ ] Tone matches project style (direct, no bullshit)
